title: Loot tables and rarity model
description: Per-monster drop tables and the global rarity weights/affix-count ranges loot rolls use, including the elite-kill rarity bias (G7, docs/0020). `monster_id` references shared/monsters.json ids and `base_pool` references shared/items.json base ids; cross-file integrity is asserted by the game data tests. Loaded identically by the Godot client and the Go server.

schema_version.description: Bumped on any breaking change to this file's shape.

rarities.description: Every rarity a roll can produce, weighted. Order is the pick order for the deterministic weighted draw, so reordering entries changes roll outcomes.

id.description: Stable snake_case identifier; never reused or renamed.

weight.description: Relative pick weight against the other rarities for a normal kill.

elite_weight.description: Relative pick weight against the other rarities for an elite kill (G7, docs/0020) - LootRoller.roll_drop(is_elite=true) reads this column instead of `weight` for the same single weighted draw. Set higher on rarer tiers than `weight` to bias elite loot upward.

affix_count_max.description: Inclusive; clamped at roll time to the affixes eligible for the base's slot.

drop_chance.description: Probability that killing this monster drops one item.

base_pool.description: Item base ids from shared/items.json this monster can drop, picked uniformly.
